profile.headline: Ruby on Rails Developer
profile.summary:
Backend developer/devops with Ruby on Rails and AWS.

●	Broad experience with design, implementation, deployment and support of evolving web applications.
●	Experience helping customers develop requirements.
●	Enjoy analyzing and solving complicated problems. Avoiding them is even better.
●	Excellent technical writing, analytical and creative problem solving skills.  
●	Experienced with Ruby on Rails, web APIs, AJAX, HTML, JavaScript, JQuery and relational databases including PostgreSQL and MySQL.
●	Scaling, caching, Docker, AWS, and deploying are fun.
●	Automating the repetitive frees one to innovate.
●	Experience with automated testing, continuous integration and continuous deployment.

positions.title: Principal Web Developer
positions.description: Building applications that manage data for devices, licenses, shipping, returns and many other internal processes.  Extensive use of MySQL and Salesforce.  Implemented and maintained bulk data upload to Salesforce.  Troubleshot complex problems involving multiple aging and poorly documented systems.

positions.title: Contract Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Implemented new features and fixes in a PHP 5.6 web application.
Migrated the PHP application from PHP 5.6 to 7.2.
Created docker images for both versions of the PHP application.  
Integrated local MacOS development environment with docker containers using gulp.
Developed data synchronization scripts using Ruby.  
Created an internal web application using Ruby on Rails 5.2, React, an API for data, and Bootstrap.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Configured Circle CI for automated testing and deployment.
Some node.js and Python experience with in AWS Lambda functions.
Built various web hooks using API Gateway, Lambda, SNS and SQS.
Built lead nurture system delivering timed email over several weeks considering many conditions.
Developed or migrated applications with Rails 2, 3, 4 and 5.  Deployed all of them using Docker to AWS Elastic Beanstalk.
Created bean_docker gem for easy creation of additional docker containers on Elastic Beanstalk instances for testing and diagnostics. 
Experience with AWS SDK gem, including utilities that initialize local application environments mirroring Beanstalk environments.
Experience deploying Rails apps with Capistrano in both traditional Unix environments  Rails application and EC2.
Deployment of applications to AWS EC2 using Capistrano, Boto, the AWS SDK gem, AWS CLI.  Experience with ELB and auto-scaling groups.

positions.title: Ruby on Rails Developer at FICO
positions.description: Created a web application designed to allow customers to try a decision-making application as a service.  Created, modified and destroyed vApps using VMWare’s vCloud Director’s API.  Created DNS entries with the Infoblox API.  Used Rails 4.0.0 and Devise for authentication.  Roles were managed roles with CanCan.  Deployed to RHEL 6 virtual machine having no access to the Internet, using Apache and Phusion Passenger, and Sidkiq to run tasks in the background.

positions.title: Web Development Consultant working at Apple
positions.description:
Created an internal web application for Core OS using Ruby on Rails, Postgres and jqPlot that presents project progress visually.

Experience Apache, Phusion Passenger, git, Capistrano, and the Rails asset pipeline.  Created mechanism to import data from an enterprise data store.  Worked with access control systems to ensure users could only access authorized resources.  Used the jqplot charting library to produce line and pie charts indicating status.  Implemented caching for charts and for external data.  Created ways for users to see their own progress, their own permissions and synchronization activities that affected their use of the system.

positions.title: President
positions.description: I've developed a unique approach to eliminating muscular stiffness and am now working on technology that shares that knowledge with people everywhere.

positions.title: Contract Web Application Developer with Apple
positions.description:
Managed the development and deployment of an internal application.

Implemented numerous features that made the system easier to use.

Migrated from Rails 1.2.3 to 2.3.8 and then Rails 3.

Upgraded the installation from a single mongrel to multiple Phusion Passenger processes.

Set up automated deployment process using Capistrano.

Used jQuery to streamline the application's javascript and support unobtrusive javascript.

Added the ability to drag and drop elements in a table-based tree using jQuery UI plugins that update the database in real time.

Improved application speed through refactoring, caching and redesign.  

Implemented a connection to internal system that enables users to make use of data with a single click.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Aspiring Author and Entrepreneur
positions.description:
- Developing a web application with Ruby on Rails that will let people share and leverage what they know about those they meet online.

- Writing a book about the future economic and social effects of robotic technology.

- Developing an idea for a medical diagnostic machine.

positions.title: Chief Architect
positions.description:
Chief Architect

- Third employee.

- Led design, implementation and deployment efforts to evolve Mentorware system into hosted application service.

- Designed server-side APIs for system’s online conference and webinar features.

- Devised numerous scalability improvements.

- Designed and implemented tools and APIs for managing cluster machines.

- Pushed for significant user interface improvements to system.

- Guided design and implementation of requirements by company's offshore development team.

- Created script-based common tool set for development, deployment, and reporting. 

- Analyzed complex issues through various layers of architecture, isolated root causes and recommended and/or implemented effective solutions.

- Developed database migration scripts.

- Installed and upgraded systems at customer sites.

- Worked with customers to develop requirements.

- Developed training materials and presented classroom training for customers.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
Enhanced an existing Java floor plan applet so that reservations for offices could be reserved on a server.

Assisted customers with the installation of IBM's NetCommerce product and the construction of their store catalogs.

Packaged desktop applications for remote installation to sales force laptops using C and IBM's proprietary software installation system.

Submitted several ideas to IBM's Idea program, one of which was used to market IBM's desktop operating system OS/2.
